newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb kills 12 in Algerian car market.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills 12 in Algerian car market.

text.p: A bomb killed 12 people and wounded many others in a car market in Boufarik, 30 km (20 miles) south of the Algerian capital Algiers, on Thursday, Algerian security forces said.

The explosion ripped through the car market at 10 a.m (0900 GMT). Several of those wounded were in a serious state, the Algerian security forces said in a statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS.

About 60,000 people have been killed in Algeria's war between the military-backed government and Islamist rebels since early 1992, when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
